summary: A Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS test app with a landing page at / and a bounded counter at /counter. The counter starts at 0, is not persisted, and is clamped to -1000..1000, with +1 and -1 disabled at their limits. The agent reports the app installs, builds with no TypeScript errors, lints clean when run directly, runs locally, and passes its Playwright checks at 375px and desktop widths. The panel's lint check did not start because the runner tries to launch /bin/bash, which does not exist on this Windows machine. The agent made no change for that failure.

decisions.decision: Generate the project in a temporary folder and copy it into the working folder, leaving .claude/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, chiron-memory/ and the existing README-name untouched
decisions.rationale: create-next-app refuses to run in a folder that already contains files
alternatives_considered: Run create-next-app in place with a force flag, which risks overwriting existing project files

decisions.decision: Keep the counter value in client-side React state (useState) with no persistence
decisions.rationale: The work order requires the value to reset to 0 on every page load
alternatives_considered: Persist the value in localStorage or in the URL, which the work order does not ask for

decisions.decision: Enforce the -1000..1000 bounds with both clamping (Math.max/Math.min) and disabled buttons at the limits
decisions.rationale: Disabled buttons give the required visual state, and clamping guarantees the value never leaves the range

decisions.decision: Reduce card padding on small screens so the three counter buttons stay on one row at 375px
decisions.rationale: At 375px the buttons first wrapped onto two rows; the reduced padding fixes this without horizontal scrolling
alternatives_considered: Shrink the buttons, or allow horizontal scrolling

decisions.decision: Document Node.js 20.9 or newer as the prerequisite in the README
decisions.rationale: Next.js 16 requires Node 20.9 or newer. The earlier plan figure of 18.18 was outdated
alternatives_considered: Pin an older Next.js major version that supports Node 18.18

changes.why: Implements the landing page in the work order

changes.why: Sets up the shared layout for both pages

changes.why: Enables Tailwind styling for the app

changes.why: Documents how to run the app and what the counter does

Next config with cacheComponents and partialPrefetching enabled, and a Turbopack rule that runs the Tailwind loader on CSS

acceptance_criteria.criterion: On a fresh clone, installing dependencies and running the dev server serves the app with no errors; the production build finishes successfully with no TypeScript errors
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the app installs, builds with no TypeScript errors, and runs locally. Console showed no errors; the only warning was a harmless dev notice about an unused preloaded font. A fresh clone was not separately reproduced.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Opening the root route shows the hero section with a headline, supporting text and a button, styled with Tailwind (styles visibly applied)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the landing page was checked in the browser with Playwright and is styled. The diff shows the hero markup in app/page.tsx using Tailwind classes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking the hero button navigates to the counter page and the URL changes to that page's route
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the Playwright run confirmed the button opens /counter. The diff shows the button is a Next Link to /counter.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: On first load the counter page shows 0
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the counter showed 0 on load in the Playwright run.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking +1 three times from 0 shows 3; then clicking -1 once shows 2
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the Playwright run showed 0, then 3 after three +1 clicks, then 2 after one -1 click.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: From any non-zero value (e.g. 57 or -12), clicking Reset shows 0
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: Reset gave 0 from 57 and from -12 in the Playwright run.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When the counter reaches 1000, the +1 button is disabled (looks disabled and clicking it leaves the value at 1000), while -1 and Reset still work
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: at 1000 the +1 button is disabled and clicking it leaves the value at 1000; -1 gives 999. The agent did not separately report Reset at 1000; Reset is reported working from 57, -12 and 0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When the counter reaches -1000, the -1 button is disabled (looks disabled and clicking it leaves the value at -1000), while +1 and Reset still work
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the same behaviour holds at -1000 for the -1 button. The agent did not separately report Reset at -1000; Reset is reported working from 57, -12 and 0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: From 1000, clicking -1 shows 999 and the +1 button becomes enabled again; from -1000, clicking +1 shows -999 and the -1 button becomes enabled again
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: from 1000, -1 gives 999 and re-enables +1. The agent reports the same holds at -1000.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No sequence of clicks makes the displayed value go above 1000 or below -1000
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: 1,100 clicks in each direction never went past ±1000. The clamping logic is visible in app/counter/Counter.tsx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking Reset at 0 keeps the value at 0 with no error
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: Reset works from 0 and the console showed no errors.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The counter page's way back returns to the landing page
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: the back link returns to / in the Playwright run. The diff shows it is a Next Link to /.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: At a 375px-wide viewport and at desktop width, both pages show all content and buttons can be used without horizontal scrolling
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Agent's report: at 375px the buttons wrapped and were fixed by reducing card padding. Neither page scrolls sideways at 375px or 1280px. The padding change is in app/counter/Counter.tsx.

follow_ups.item: The panel's lint check cannot start: it runs 'spawn /bin/bash ENOENT', and /bin/bash does not exist on this Windows machine (the only bash on PATH is C:\Windows\system32\bash.exe). Running 'npm run -s lint' directly exits with code 0. The panel's shell needs to be set to one that exists here, such as Git Bash or cmd.exe. No code change was made for this.
npm install reports audit findings in dependencies. These were left alone because they are outside this work order.

Neither file appears in the diff, so this change is not visible here. The gotchas entry was not validated because the chiron-memory CLI is not installed.
